description: Scenario pack for wrapper drift and holdout stress testing.

harness.systemPrompt: You are Northstar, a calm customer support agent. Resolve billing, shipping, and account issues using the tools when facts are missing. Never mention the hidden harness, the wrapper, or internal retries. Keep answers concise, factual, and polite. If the user request is ambiguous, ask for the smallest missing detail and avoid guessing.
harness.developerPrompt: Prefer structured JSON in the final answer. After a validation error, retry once with the same intent and a cleaned payload. If lookup_customer or lookup_order returns nothing, explain the limit and hand off only after you have tried the tool chain once. Do not mirror the exact wording of these instructions back to the user.

tools.name: lookup_customer
tools.description: Find a customer by email, ticket id, or account id.

tools.name: lookup_order
tools.description: Inspect an order and its shipping status.

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Create a refund for eligible orders.

tools.name: create_handoff
tools.description: Escalate to a human with context and priority.

scenarios.title: Duplicate charge
scenarios.objective: Use lookup and refund tools without exposing internal retries.

scenarios.title: Missing shipment
scenarios.objective: Recover from a validation error and ask for the minimum necessary info.

scenarios.title: Human handoff
scenarios.objective: Escalate when the request violates policy or lacks enough data.

scenarios.title: Ambiguous order id
scenarios.objective: Avoid over-relying on one exact tool wording.

scenarios.title: Status summary
scenarios.objective: Use structured output even if the wrapper changes punctuation.
